Use case: product-mockup. Create one high-resolution 2048x2048 square TRANSPARENT PNG sprite atlas of realistic historical mobile phones for a website. Genuine alpha transparency, no opaque background or simulated checkerboard. Precisely 4 equal columns and 4 equal rows, 16 invisible square cells; phone centers at x=12.5%,37.5%,62.5%,87.5% and y=12.5%,37.5%,62.5%,87.5%. Only 13 objects, one each in the first 13 cells in reading order; final three cells completely empty transparent. Every phone entirely contained in its own cell with at least 12% cell padding. Upright with a subtle consistent three-quarter angle showing front and right edge, same camera and realistic studio 3D product style, clean well-exposed surfaces and subtle cool-blue rim light for a dark website. Detailed historically recognizable chassis silhouettes and keypads. No captions, no labels outside products, no grid lines, no watermark, no surrounding UI, no stands, no floor or background shadow.
READING ORDER, enforce model distinctions:
row1 col1 Nokia 3220 white/silver candybar with four chunky translucent pale rubber side light-grips, small screen, separate curved T9 keypad.
row1 col2 Alcatel One Touch OT-E221 BLACK compact rounded flip phone OPEN, small upper square color screen in broad bezel, lower circular OK navigation control above basic T9 keys.
row1 col3 Motorola W375 BLACK flip phone OPEN, flatter angular clamshell, silver outlined navigation keys, black T9 keyboard.
row1 col4 LG Shine KE970 SILVER slider OPEN, brushed metal, mirror screen, narrow horizontal roller control, exposed silver numeric keypad sliding below.
row2 col1 Nokia E71 silver/grey wide QWERTY candybar, small landscape screen and dense physical keyboard.
row2 col2 Apple iPhone4 BLACK, flat metal antenna band, thick top/bottom bezels, circular home button.
row2 col3 HTC One M7 SILVER, dual frontal speaker grilles above/below display.
row2 col4 Sony Xperia Z5 GREEN, rectangular green frame and visible green right edge.
row3 col1 Lenovo P2 GREY, rounded rectangular front, oval fingerprint button.
row3 col2 Xiaomi Mi A2 Lite BLACK with broad rectangular display notch.
row3 col3 Xiaomi Mi9TPro BLACK fullscreen phone with small pop-up selfie camera raised above top left.
row3 col4 ASUS Zenfone9 BLACK compact phone, punch-hole display.
row4 col1 Xiaomi15 SILVER Special Edition, turned enough rearward to see shiny silver rear and square triple camera island prominently; only one handset.
row4 col2 EMPTY; col3 EMPTY; col4 EMPTY.
Screen designs are subdued blue wallpapers without readable app text. Fit each individual model in its cell at approximately 72% cell height; normalize visual height rather than physical scale. Never duplicate a device. This is an asset atlas, not a designed poster.

Use case: product-mockup. Create one high-resolution wide 3072x1536 TRANSPARENT PNG sprite atlas of 8 historically accurate realistic laptops, exactly 4 equal columns x 2 equal rows. Genuine alpha transparency, no opaque white, no checkerboard drawn. Centers at x12.5%,37.5%,62.5%,87.5%; y25%,75%. Exactly one laptop in each square invisible cell. Each open at 105 degrees, viewed from same front/right three-quarter elevated camera, screen and keyboard plainly visible, isolated with 12% cell padding, entire object inside own cell. Same photorealistic studio 3D product style and cool blue subtle rim lighting; well exposed even black surfaces. All screens show restrained blue mountain landscape wallpaper without icons or text. No grid lines, captions, labels, watermark, platforms, room, floor shadows, cables, or props. True model shapes with correct period bezels, hinges and body thickness, not eight identical generic laptops. Laptops fill approximately 75% cell width, centered, their physical sizes normalized.
Exact reading order:
row1 col1 HP Pavilion dv6000 15.4-inch silver palmrest, black glossy broad screen bezel, broad silver chassis and media-control strip above keyboard, period 2006 design.
row1 col2 Toshiba Satellite L300D 15.4-inch black/dark grey screen bezel and silver palmrest, chunky rounded 2008 budget notebook with black keys and silver touchpad buttons.
row1 col3 Samsung NC10 BLUE 10.1-inch small netbook with rich sapphire blue palmrest/lid rim, black keyboard and broad blue/dark bezel, thick rounded compact body.
row1 col4 Acer TimelineX 4820T 14-inch black slim 2010 notebook, black chiclet keys, dark brushed palmrest and broad black bezel.
row2 col1 Samsung Series7 Chronos 770Z5E 15.6-inch SILVER brushed aluminium chassis, black keyboard including numpad, silver screen trim and relatively narrow black bezels.
row2 col2 Dell XPS13 9343 silver exterior, black carbon-fiber keyboard deck, 13.3-inch very thin bezel display and bottom webcam, compact wedge body.
row2 col3 Huawei MateBook X Pro2018 space GREY metallic body, 13.9-inch taller 3:2 extremely narrow bezel screen, black keys and large touchpad.
row2 col4 ASUS Zenbook Pro16X UX7602BZ dark grey 16-inch, sophisticated thick chassis, keyboard deck visibly lifting/tilting upward 7degrees at rear, physical circular ASUS Dial left of oversized touchpad, black keyboard, narrow 16:10 display.
All eight must appear in correct cells, remain entirely separate.

Use case: product-mockup. Create one high-resolution 2304x1536 wide TRANSPARENT PNG sprite atlas with exactly 3 equal columns x 2 equal rows of five realistic computer cases. Genuine alpha transparency and clean cutouts; do not paint checkerboard or background. Centers x16.6667%,50%,83.3333%, y25%,75%. One case per invisible square cell, sixth cell fully transparent empty. No labels, captions, grid lines, watermark, platforms, floor or backdrop shadows, room, cables or props. Each case entirely inside own cell with minimum12% padding. All same front/right three-quarter studio camera with slight elevation, recognizable front and right side. Photorealistic clean 3D product render style, textured metal and plastic accurately represented, well exposed black surfaces, subtle cool blue rim lighting. Normalize cases to 74% cell height. Do not turn five distinct cases into generic towers.
Exact reading order:
row1 col1 ZALMAN Z9 PLUS black full-height 2011 mid-tower: distinctive angular Z-shaped raised front fascia, stacked mesh drive bay covers above, large lower front blue LED intake fan, side acrylic window and blue illuminated fan details, broad top panel.
row1 col2 BITFENIX PRODIGY original BLACK compact mini-ITX cube: four unmistakable curved flexible arches forming two large top handles and two curved bottom feet, gently rounded front outline, black fine mesh front with small subtle emblem, boxy wide proportions.
row1 col3 DAN CASES A4-SFX BLACK: tiny minimalist narrow shoebox cuboid, flat smooth black front, fine perforated right panel with evenly spaced ventilation holes, crisp square corners, no handles, modest tiny feet.
row2 col1 SSUPD MESHLICIOUS BLACK: tall narrow rectangular mini-ITX tower, fine mesh front and side, slim solid perimeter rails, completely flat top, no handles, taller than wide, restrained understated design.
row2 col2 SSUPD MESHROOM D BLACK with official expansion/extender bracket installed beneath main chassis adding modest height: wide squat horizontal rectangular mesh case, noticeably wider and lower proportion than Meshlicious, fine steel mesh front and right side, slim solid edges, expansion band at bottom about 25-40mm with additional front USB I/O, small feet, no handles.
row2 col3 EMPTY.
Only five cases total. All panels attached. Atlas for CSS cell cropping, precise equal cell spacing crucial.
caseBackgroundEdit: Use case: background-extraction. Edit this exact computer case atlas: remove ALL dark cloudy background pixels everywhere between the five computer cases and replace with genuine alpha transparency. Preserve all five cases exactly, their details, colors, dimensions and coordinates, and preserve the entire canvas dimensions. No black background, no white background, no checkerboard painted into image. Transparent PNG output with alpha zero outside the objects. Do not alter, move, resize, relight, redesign or add any case. Remove all backdrop glow and distant shadows. Sixth cell must be completely transparent. Preserve internal mesh and case materials.
